summary: AdvanSix Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to report Q1 2026 financial results and declare a $0.16 per share cash dividend payable June 2, 2026 to holders of record May 19, 2026. The press release also notes the appointment of Patrick Day as SVP and CFO effective April 27, 2026, and mentions evaluating expansion of its integrated ammonia platform for diesel exhaust fluid demand. No M&A transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event is described. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement with a standard management change.
